newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt warns against wage complacency.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt warns against wage complacency.

text.p: Australian Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith said on Thursday there was no room for complacency on wages growth.
Reith was commenting on the release of official data earlier on Thursday showing average wages growth of 1.2 percent in the three months to November and 3.9 percent over the past 12 months.

"Whilst the numbers should not be seen as evidence of any acceleration in aggregate wages growth, I do think a point needs to be made and that is that there is absolutley no room for complacency on this whole question of wages growth in terms of the better economic management of the economy," Reith told parliament.
He said there was little substantive evidence of a slowing in enterprise bargaining wage outcomes.
The government has warned excessive wages growth could fuel inflation while the Reserve Bank has made plain that it is keenly watching wages in its monetary policy deliberations.
